tips.text: Run Kullervo's Hold solo; public squads farm Decrees for 40 minutes or more and stall on the Orowyrm.
Run it on normal, not Steel Path; the longer run costs more than the extra Bane is worth.
Do not wait for The Warden if he is not above the arena; the fight comes later as a main objective.
Collect at least 5 Decrees before speaking to The Warden.
Use Transference Sync to a modded Warframe if the Kullervo fight goes badly.
Fight Kullervo with melee and finishers; primaries and secondaries lose damage against him.
Climb the Orowyrm by jumping off and re-grappling repeatedly, and hop off to re-grapple through its energy ring every 30 seconds or so.
Skip the Kaithe for Wyrmlings; step outside the ring of fire or wall-latch and shoot them.
